Hygloss is an American made brand of arts and crafts products for teachers, parents and students. Who are Hygloss products for?
Are you a teacher at a kindergarten, preschool, elementary school, public school, private school or homeschool, etc.?
Are you a parent who cares about your child’s learning through creativity, imagination and exploration?
Are you a nanny, tutor or caretaker of energetic young children who are bright and enjoy engaging in fun and educational activities?

Hygloss products are tailored specifically for you and your children/students. They are also great for adults who enjoy crafting!

Quality and Services
At Hygloss, we strive for the best products and services. We support local businesses and promote a healthy economy for our country. description:
An eco-friendly update to traditional wrapping paper, VZWraps reusable fabric gift bags help you wrap more quickly and stylishly, and there’s no trash left behind when your present is opened. Your gifts will be wrapped in minutes and you won’t have a garbage bag full of crumpled paper after the next birthday party, bridal shower, or other celebration. No more sitting on the floor getting a backache reaching around for scissors and tape while trying not to poke a hole in rolled out paper.

WHICH SIZE TO CHOOSE? The dimensions shown are for the flat bag.

LARGE bags can hold a present with a perimeter up to 40 inches, such as a basketball, large robe, coat, small appliances, a shirt box, or large shoe box. The ribbons are not attached to the large bags to give you more options on where to tie it for the best presentation.

MEDIUM bags can hold a gift with a perimeter up to 34 inches, such as square board games, a football, large sweatshirts, small laptops, or regular shoe boxes (not boots).

description: Present your gift with something truly special, handmade lokta wrapping paper from Nepal. Lokta paper is tree-free and made from lokta bushes which grow naturally on the Southern slopes of the Himalayas of Nepal. Strips from the bush are cooked until the fibers separate. The pulpy mash created is then spread by hand over boxed screens and set to dry on the Himalayan mountainside where the fibers reunite, creating the paper. Kathmandu Valley Co. gift wrap paper is great for birthday wrapping paper, weddings, graduation gifts, business gifts, Christmas, Hanukkah, and many more special occasions. Use the paper for wrapping gifts, or as craft paper, for art projects, or scrapbook paper. The paper comes in a roll of ten sheets with each sheet measuring 20 x 30 inches. Thank you for supporting a handmade-paper tradition special to Nepal.
